STEM Program · Team 16158

Building Robots. Building Character.

BCS Robotics is a student-driven robotics program where members learn engineering, coding, and teamwork through the VEX IQ Challenge. We bring together students who are curious about how things work to design, build, and program robots — while developing real-world skills in problem-solving and leadership.

What We Do

Hands-On, Every Week

  • Design and build robots for VEX IQ competitions
  • Learn programming and engineering design principles
  • Compete in regional and state-level tournaments
  • Mentor new members and build leadership skills
  • Engage in community outreach and STEM promotion

What Students Learn

Our Curriculum

A progressive 20-week curriculum guiding students from foundational robotics concepts through real VEX IQ tournament competition — building engineering skills, teamwork, and resilience along the way.

Module 01

Introduction to Robotics

Weeks 1–2
  • Basic robotics concepts & VEX IQ kit overview
  • Building and controlling simple robots
  • Introduction to teamwork & design thinking
Module 02

Engineering & Programming Foundations

Weeks 3–5
  • Simple machine principles: gears, wheels, levers, sensors
  • Programming basics using VEXcode IQ
  • Trial-and-error design & iteration
Module 03

Applied Robotics Challenges

Weeks 6–8
  • Building robots to complete specific tasks
  • Problem-solving in collaborative groups
  • Introduction to competition-style challenges
Module 04

Showcase & Competition Prep

Weeks 9–20
  • Team projects solving complex challenges
  • Showcase event for parents & school community
  • Participation in 2026–27 VEX IQ Tournaments in Maryland

Who Can Join

No Experience Necessary

No experience necessary! Whether you're new to robotics or already have some background in engineering or coding, there's a place for you on our team.
